notes.title: Understanding the Victim
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Development is in full swing, the playtest is providing a lot of useful feedback (thanks for that, by the way!), and we'd like to stay in touch with you more often. So while we're debating what kind of [i]juicy[/i] stuff to share with you without spoiling too much, we wanted to talk about something new we learned ourselves during development.[/p][p]And if you like this format, we'll share more like it. Guys, have you ever wondered… [/p][h3][b]…why victims often can't describe the attacker's face?[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980827/141ff3c12d095a4fc6bf0d8ceb89356848fba455.png"][/img][/p][p]Some people think: "How can you not remember the attacker's face? It's obvious!" But neuroscience explains that it's not that simple.[/p][p][b]🔹 Survival Mode[/b]
Under extreme stress, the activity of the prefrontal cortex decreases. This area of the brain is responsible for logic and memory. At the same time, the amygdala—the center of fear and anxiety—takes over. The brain switches its priority to: survive.[/p][p][b]🔹 Tunnel Vision[/b]
A person focuses on the threat—for example, on a knife or a gun—or on the escape route. Everything else, including the criminal's face, becomes peripheral.[/p][p][b]🔹 Dissociation[/b]
Some people experience a state of "detachment": it's as if you're watching what's happening from the outside. Memories from such moments are fragmentary—smells, sounds, and sensations remain, but not a complete picture.[/p][p]🔹[b] Hormones and Memory[/b]
Cortisol and adrenaline can both enhance and disrupt memory consolidation. When stress levels are excessive, it "breaks" memory, leaving only fragments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980827/b17d1cbafbe70e799cc47562e5d41b84defd086f.png"][/img][/p][p]It's important to remember: none of this makes the victim's account unreliable. On the contrary, understanding these processes helps us treat trauma survivors with respect and without blame.[/p][p]So there you have it… you learn all sorts of things while creating a psychological thriller about an abducted girl 💀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980827/e99cca3f0692ca62f8b1d27ef1cfb373b0e4561f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thank you for an incredible playtest start!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]A week ago, the Lost in the Roots playtest began, and we are still reeling from how the launch and first days went. Your response and interest in the game have been overwhelming, and we want to thank each and every one of you from the bottom of our hearts![/p][p]Thank you for deciding to embark on this journey ^^[/p][p][/p][p]We’d like to share some stats and first impressions with you because without you, none of this would have been possible:[/p][list][*][p]Nearly 7,500 brave souls signed up for the test![/p][/*][*][p]Of those, over 2,000 have already spent time in our world.[/p][/*][*][p]On top of that, around 350 people log into the game daily.[/p][/*][/list][p]We are pleasantly surprised! But most importantly – your feedback and attention to detail. Nearly 800 players didn't just finish the demo; they also completed the survey questionnaire, sharing their thoughts and impressions of the game. We are thrilled that so many people decided to help us.[/p][p][/p][h3]What are your thoughts on the game? [/h3][p]After reviewing every one of your messages and survey responses, we've realized we're moving in the right direction. Because:[/p][p]Of those who provided a rating, over 50% gave the game the highest score. 36.2% rated the game as "Good" (4 stars). However, we haven't forgotten about the remaining 12% of players who gave ratings between 3 and 1 star. The team has a clear-eyed view of what the game is currently lacking. The average playtime is 33 minutes, which aligns perfectly with the planned length of the demo version (25-30 minutes). This means you’re genuinely interested in seeing how it all ends ;)[/p][p]What delights you the most is our art style (37% highlighted this as the strongest aspect) and the storyline (42%). We consider this an excellent result, as these aspects are among the most crucial for this genre.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s next?[/h3][p]Your feedback is our compass, guiding our development path. We’ve already compiled a list of adjustments: from minor bug fixes to improvements for certain mechanics and elements. First and foremost, we will:[/p][list][*][p]Make the characters' dialogue more lively and natural;[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the crafting system to make it more intuitive;[/p][/*][*][p]Diversify the ambient sounds and add more tracks for the background music;[/p][/*][*][p]Add hints where they are clearly needed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you haven’t joined the testing yet – now is the time![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2872240/Lost_in_the_Roots/"][/dynamiclink]If you’ve already played but haven’t filled out the survey yet, we would be incredibly grateful for your feedback. There’s still time ;)[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your passion, your criticism, and your support.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Join the Lost in the Roots Playtest
notes.notes: [h2]Our team is thrilled to announce that registration for the playtest of our adventure game Lost in the Roots is now open! [/h2][p][/p][p]This is your chance to be among the first to step into the mysterious, living, and dangerous world where the past never lets go and the forest remembers everything. We are currently awaiting confirmation from Steam regarding the readiness of the current build, and as soon as everything is approved – we will launch the playtest. Its main goal is to show you the game itself and gather your valuable feedback to make [b]Lost in the Roots[/b] even better. [/p][p][/p][h3]What can you expect in the playtest?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980827/7d7903ccff6726d2876b6104776fc8ec15c36a35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You will immerse yourself in the beginning of Yakob’s tragic story – a man whose past has made him an outcast forever. You will experience the first day of events, where you take control of Trisha. The third day will also be available, featuring one of the most intense moments from the first third of the game – though we’ll avoid spoilers for now. [/p][p]Prepare to explore eerie rooms, solve the initial puzzles, and feel how the colossal, living Forest begins to invade the characters’ minds, reflecting their darkest memories. Will you be able to unravel the first threads of this grim tale?[/p][p][/p][h3]Don’t miss your chance to glimpse the world of Lost in the Roots before release – join the playtest![/h3][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for further news and chat with our team on social media. Share your impressions, ask questions, and keep up with all the updates![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980827/cd809c97e0b81014aab6ea273bef3cbe0b10244e.png"][/img][url="https://discord.gg/g25gaKZjVm" style="button"]JOIN OUR DISCORD HERE[/url][/p]
